summary: Extends IS-IS to support Traffic Engineering by defining new information that routers can put into link state packets. This describes additional details about the state of links, useful for traffic engineering computations such as choosing paths based on bandwidth. It replaced RFC 3784 and has been updated later.

eli5.summary: Roads carry traffic better if planners know which are busy. This lets routers also share extra facts about each link, like free room, so paths can be chosen with traffic in mind.
